skills.name: tailwind
skills.notes: Community Tailwind CSS v4 guidance, MIT. Copy all 50 files, including AGENTS.md, references, assets/templates, README.md, and metadata.json. Read references/supporting-skills.md before use: upstream examples contain known errors, including @variant instead of @custom-variant for dark-mode definition and invalid Sass-style native nesting. Official version-matched docs and the kit's corrections take precedence; this is a scoped review, not an exhaustive correctness audit.

skills.name: wagtail
skills.notes: Official Wagtail discovery skill; this folder contains one SKILL.md. Requires the separately installed wagtail-cli 0.4.0 runtime, which bundles the specialist skills and resources loaded by wt. The stub declares MIT; the repository and runtime declare BSD-3-Clause. Preserve the unmodified declaration, repository license, and provenance. CLI API operations target API v3 preview, not v2; never silently upgrade an existing CMS. See supporting-skills.md for setup and compatibility limits.
